# Chiplet_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The arrangement and interconnection of multiple chiplets within a package, forming a physical network topology that determines data movement paths. Directly influences TCC design as the on-package topology becomes the substrate for in-network compute and memory access patterns.
